modernobscurecompat.config.title: Modern Obscure Config
modernobscurecompat.config.enabled.toolt: Master switch for the smooth tooltip transition.
modernobscurecompat.config.smoothMovemen: Let the tooltip glide toward the cursor instead of snapping to it.
modernobscurecompat.config.movementSpeed: How quickly the tooltip catches up with the cursor. Higher is snappier, lower is floatier.
Jump distances above this many pixels snap instantly (avoids sliding across the cursor on side flips).
modernobscurecompat.config.smoothSize.to: Animate the tooltip size when it appears or when its content changes.
modernobscurecompat.config.sizeSpeed.too: How quickly the tooltip reaches its target size.
modernobscurecompat.config.startScale.to: Scale the tooltip starts from when it appears (1.0 = no pop-in).
